newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won closes lower despite intervention.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won closes lower despite intervention.

text.p: The won ended lower versus the dollar on Friday despite the central bank's dollar-selling intervention in the morning, traders said.
The Bank of Korea offered to sell dollars in three-month forward trading at 893.00 won in mid-morning to slow the won's fall, traders said. The bank denied the action.
The won closed at 879.30 after opening at 879.00. It traded in a range of 878.10 to 879.90.
The won was buoyed in the morning by a news report that the central bank thought the dollar level was too high and planned to intervene in the interbank market.
